verdict.rationale: Adyen for Platforms supports automation via managed payouts (automated fund disbursement) and webhooks (event-driven, no polling needed) which can trigger downstream background processes, and an official MCP server lets AI agents connect via natural language to build solutions. However, none of this evidence shows a user-facing capability to configure arbitrary autonomous AI agent workflows — it's limited to payment-specific automations (payouts, fraud flags, reconciliation) rather than general agentic task automation. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of AI agents autonomously creating/managing scheduled or triggered workflows beyond payouts/webhooks, and independent evidence of the MCP server being used for such automation.
